_about: The first draft's deploy step. It checks the signature 'when it can' and deploys anyway when it can't.
_trusted_key: release = use keys/ci.pub from the release folder itself, i.e. trust whatever key came with the model.
_ignore_unsigned_files: true = files that are not in the signature are allowed (the docs job adds a README after signing).
_on_verify_error: warn = log a warning and carry on (fail open). refuse = stop (fail closed).
